Care management succeeds on precision targeting and timely intervention: identifying rising-risk members, coordinating across providers, and proving quality outcomes. It is a data-discipline business — and the data discipline is usually the missing part.

items: Claims, clinical, SDOH and engagement data siloed; risk stratification runs on claims only.
HEDIS-class measures assembled manually per cycle; evidence assembled under deadline.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Master Data, Governance & Cataloging, Lakehouse Architecture & Migration, Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Risk stratification, Care outreach and scheduling, Program matching) on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: One customer, one product, one truth: MDM and catalog discipline that regulators can read.
Forward-looking risk on governed data: credit, insurance, operational and market models that explain themselves.
Turn the data estate into revenue: embedded analytics, data sharing and insight products with real P&L.
Claims/clinical/SDOH unified with certified risk features (stratification precise)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: protocol-driven evidence assembly with provenance for regulatory-grade studies (evidence assembly from months to weeks). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

A fixed rhythm keeps progress visible from week one — here is the one we run. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
